expectations.text: Flags domain/label-policy.ts for importing drizzle-orm / the db schema into the domain layer
expectations.evidence: Finding #1: 'The domain layer imports labels from the Drizzle db/schema.js and re-exports labelsTableRef/byId... coupling the innermost layer to a persistence/ORM technology'

expectations.text: Flags application/use-cases/create-label.ts for importing a Fastify type into the application layer
expectations.evidence: Finding #5: 'The use case takes a FastifyRequest parameter and calls req.log.info(...), pulling a framework-specific (Fastify) transport type into the application layer'

expectations.text: Flags adapters/inbound/http/labels.routes.ts for querying the database directly instead of calling a use case
expectations.evidence: Finding #2: 'The GET route bypasses the application layer entirely and queries db.select().from(labels)... skipping the use case and the repository port'

eval_feedback.overall: Baseline (no skill) caught all 3 planted violations plus 5 extra, legitimate findings (unvalidated input, missing composition-root wiring, mixed domain/persistence concerns, unmapped DB row leaking through the port). General Clean/Onion Architecture knowledge was sufficient here without this project's specific skill.
